articles.title: JG Chemicals Is Getting Ready For A Fresh All-Time High
articles.description: JG Chemicals has been moving inside this large rising channel since listing and the reactions from both boundaries have been extremely clean. Every major test of the lower trendline has attracted buyers while the upper trendline has repeatedly created profit booking. But this time the structure looks much stronger. After bouncing from the lower channel near 300 the stock has almost doubled and returned to the 680–700 resistance zone with strong momentum. Even after the recent rejection buyers did not allow any major correction and price is already pushing back towards the highs. That shows supply near the upper boundary is getting absorbed much faster than before. The real trigger now is a clean breakout and sustain above 700. This would not only break the upper channel resistance but also push the stock into fresh all-time highs and price discovery. Liquidity is sitting above these highs and once it gets taken out the breakout can attract fresh momentum buyers very quickly. RSI around 73 also shows how strong the current momentum is. If 700 finally gives way JG Chemicals can move into a completely new expansion phase and the next rally can be much sharper than the previous ones.
articles.sentiment: ONLY AVAILABLE IN PROFESSIONAL AND CORPORATE PLANS

articles.title: Arfin India Looks Ready For Its Next Powerful Rally
articles.description: Stock is again testing the 96–98 falling resistance that has controlled every major rally since May. What makes this attempt important is the pressure building underneath. The stock continues to respect its rising trendline and the recent sharp fall towards 80–82 was immediately bought, showing buyers are still aggressively defending the broader bullish structure. Since then price has rebuilt momentum and today’s strong move has pushed it directly back towards resistance with a clear expansion in volume. Repeated tests of the same falling trendline while support keeps moving higher usually means supply is slowly getting absorbed. Now a clean breakout and sustain above 98–100 can completely change the short-term structure. Sellers have rejected price from this trendline several times and their liquidity is sitting just above these previous highs. Once 100 starts holding the same traders expecting another rejection can get trapped and that can accelerate momentum towards the 104–108 zone and eventually fresh highs. RSI has also jumped back above 60 which supports the strength visible in price. Arfin has spent months building pressure below this resistance and this breakout can finally release the next strong bullish leg.

articles.title: Meesho Is One Breakout Away From Entering Price Discovery
articles.description: Meesho is back near the 245–250 zone where the stock faced heavy selling soon after listing and again got rejected recently. But the structure underneath has changed completely. Since the March bottom price has consistently formed higher lows along the rising trendline and every correction towards this support has attracted buyers. Even the latest rejection from 250 failed to create any major weakness. Buyers absorbed the fall quickly and pushed price straight back towards the same resistance. This repeated pressure near the highs shows supply is getting weaker while accumulation continues below. Now the setup is very simple. A strong breakout and sustain above 250 can clear the biggest supply zone visible on the chart and push Meesho into fresh all-time highs and price discovery. Liquidity is sitting above these highs and once that gets taken out fresh breakout buyers can enter while traders expecting another rejection may get trapped. RSI has also recovered above 60 which supports the improving momentum. If 250 finally gives way this entire structure can open up and the next expansion towards 280+ can happen much faster than many expect.

articles.title: MP: Two cheetahs set for release in Veerangana Durgavati Reserve
articles.description: Two cheetahs from Kuno National Park will be shifted to the Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh on October 7.Chief Minister Mohan Yadav will release the male cheetah, â€˜Tholoâ€™, and female cheetah, â€˜CCB-3â€™, into the reserve.With this, Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve will become the third cheetah habitat in Madhya Pradesh after Kuno National Park and Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary.The two cheetahs will initially be housed in a 439-hectare enclosure prepared by the Forest Department.The area has been equipped with bomas and other facilities to ensure the animalsâ€™ safety and acclimatisation.The department has also made arrangements for regular monitoring and healthcare of the cheetahs.According to a state government statement, special arrangements have been made across approximately 439 hectares to facilitate the animalsâ€™ safety and acclimatisation.Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve spans around 2,339 square kilometres across Sagar, Damoh and Narsinghpur districts.It is the largest tiger reserve in Madhya Pradesh.The reserve was earlier known as the Nauradehi Tiger Reserve.It received tiger reserve status in September 2023 following the integration of the Nauradehi Wildlife Sanctuary.The reserve is named after Rani Durgavati, the 16th-century Gond queen remembered for her resistance against Mughal forces.The reserve is home to tigers, leopards, chital, sambar, nilgai and bears.It is also an important habitat for several endangered vulture species.The relocation forms part of efforts to establish cheetahs in additional suitable habitats across Madhya Pradesh.The state government said the move would also help promote wildlife tourism in the Sagar-Bundelkhand region.According to the government, the release of the two cheetahs will make Veerangana Durgavati the third cheetah habitat in Madhya Pradesh.The relocation comes a day after five cubs were born at Kuno National Park.India-born female cheetah KJP21 gave birth to the cubs on October 5.Indiaâ€™s cheetah population has now reached 60, including 41 born in the country.All 60 cheetahs are currently in Madhya Pradesh.Following the relocation, Kuno National Park will have 54 cheetahs, Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary will have four, and Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve will have two.Project Cheetah was launched on September 17, 2022, with the release of eight cheetahs brought from Namibia into Kuno National Park.Another 12 cheetahs were brought from South Africa in 2023.The project aims to re-establish a viable cheetah population in India.The species was declared extinct in the country in 1952.The proposed shift to Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve marks the latest step in expanding the programme beyond Kuno and creating multiple habitats for the species.
